mapper.select:
SELECT FROM PA_SUMMARY_HAE PA WHERE PA.PAY_SCHEDULE_NO = #{payScheduleNo, jdbcType=VARCHAR}
AND (PA.EMPID LIKE #{key, jdbcType=VARCHAR} || '%' OR CONVERTTOUNSIGN(UPPER(PA.LOCAL_NAME)) LIKE '%' || CONVERTTOUNSIGN(UPPER(#{key, jdbcType=VARCHAR})) || '%')
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM HR_DEPARTMENT B1 WHERE B1.DEPTNO = PA.DEPTNO AND B1.CPNY_ID = #{cpnyId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} START WITH B1.DEPTNO = #{deptNo, jdbcType=VARCHAR} CONNECT BY PRIOR B1.DEPTNO = B1.PARENT_DEPT_NO)
ORDER BY PA.EMPID

SELECT , TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(PA.PAY_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), 'DD-MM-YYYY') PAY_DATE, TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(PA.PAY_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), 'DD/MM/YYYY') PAY_DATE_FORMAT FROM PA_SUMMARY_HAE PA WHERE SUBSTR(PA.PAY_DATE, 0, 7) BETWEEN TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(#{startMonth, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'MM/YYYY'), 'YYYY-MM') AND TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(#{endMonth, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'MM/YYYY'), 'YYYY-MM') AND PA.PERSON_ID = #{personId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} ORDER BY PA.PAY_DATE
